body.message:
The property is a 1-bedroom apartment in Al Safa, available at AED 6,999/month, all-inclusive. Water, electricity, internet, and VAT are all covered, so nothing extra on top of that.

Al Safa is a quiet, well-connected area right off Sheikh Zayed Road, close to City Walk, Jumeirah, and Downtown Dubai.

May 1st works as a move-in date. Would you like to see some photos of the apartment?
